subject: Vertex MAP — Weekly checkpoints, owners & success criteria
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lori Chen <lori@vertexinsights.com>, Tom Gleason <tom.g@vertexinsights.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vertex MAP — Weekly checkpoints, owners & success criteria

Hi Lori / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Vertex_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short evaluation checklist (evaluation-checklist.pdf) to help structure the next 6 weeks.

Proposed kickoff & cadence:
- Weekly 30-minute checkpoints (Tuesdays, 30 min) — quick status, blockers, decisions.
- Bi-weekly technical deep-dive (optional / ad-hoc) for evaluation team.

Primary success criteria (to align on at kickoff):
1) End-to-end inference latency under 220ms P95 for sample workload.
2) Cost-per-1k tokens within agreed target range (will be driven by batching & quantization config).
3) Integration proof-of-concept running in your staging environment with synthetic traffic by week 4.

Draft owners (suggested):
- Redwood: Diego (overall), Stephanie (technical eval lead), Monica (CS & rollout plan)
- Vertex: Lori (product), Tom (platform), Procurement contact (contracting)

Action items ahead of kickoff (please try to complete by Monday):
- Lori: confirm attendees and preferred Tuesday time window.
- Tom: share staging credentials for the envoy/ingress endpoint (read-only).
- Stephanie: upload the evaluation checklist to the shared Drive (link below).

Attachments: Vertex_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), evaluation-checklist.pdf (checklist + sample data schema)
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bVertexMAP

If that works I’ll schedule a 30-minute recurring invite and we’ll use the MAP sheet as the running tracker during each checkpoint.

Thanks — looking forward to getting moving.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0199

From: Lori Chen <lori@vertexinsights.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Gleason <tom.g@vertexinsights.com>, procurement@vertexinsights.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vertex MAP — Weekly checkpoints, owners & success criteria

Diego — thanks, this is very clear. We like the proposed cadence but prefer Tuesdays at 11:00am PT instead of morning. Small request: can we fold the bi-weekly deep-dive into the Tuesday cadence every other week so engineering has a predictable slot?

I confirmed attendees internally: myself (product), Tom (platform), plus Rajiv (data engineering) who assists with staging. Procurement looped in for contracting timelines.

Quick notes on success criteria:
- Latency target: we can commit to validating 220ms P95 for our baseline traffic if Redwood provides a recommended batching/config doc (Steph — can you add that to the checklist?).
- For staging creds: we can provide a time-limited API key and a kube-service account — Tom will follow up.

Please go ahead and send the recurring invite for Tuesdays at 11:00 PT.

Lori / team —

I’ll take technical lead for the evaluation. I uploaded a first-pass recommended config section into the Drive and added inline notes in the evaluation checklist about sample payloads and batch-sizing for the P95 target.

Quick checklist items I assigned to myself in the MAP sheet:
- Confirm synthetic traffic generator and sample payloads (due: 2026-02-24)
- Create a short, reproducible perf-run script for your staging (due: 2026-02-26)
- Provide Redwood recommended batching/kv-cache settings and quantization flavor doc (due: 2026-02-24)

Monica — can you take the rollout/CS readiness owner (customer success plan + notification template)? I’ll coordinate with Tom on creds.

Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lori Chen <lori@vertexinsights.com>, Tom Gleason <tom.g@vertexinsights.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Vertex MAP — Checkpoint #1 notes (2026-02-25)

Team — great kickoff today. Notes and decisions below (captured from the MAP sheet and today's call).

Attendees: Lori (Vertex product), Tom (Vertex platform), Rajiv (Vertex data eng), Diego, Stephanie, Monica, Vivek.

Decisions made:
- Weekly checkpoints: Tuesdays 11:00 PT recurring (30 min). First checkpoint completed today.
- Staging creds: Tom to provide a time-limited API key and a read-only kube-service account by EOD Thurs (2026-02-26).
- Performance baseline: Redwood to run initial perf-run in our lab using Vertex sample payloads by 2026-02-27.

Action items (owners & due dates):
1) Tom (Vertex) — share staging API key & kube-service account (due: 2026-02-26).
2) Stephanie (Redwood) — perf-run script + recommended batching settings (due: 2026-02-26).
3) Monica (Redwood) — customer rollout checklist draft and staging run monitoring plan (due: 2026-03-03).
4) Lori (Vertex) — finalize sample traffic profile and share CSV schema (due: 2026-02-24) [NOTE: met during call].
5) Diego (Redwood) — update MAP with firm close timeline proposal (due: 2026-03-05).

Risks / blockers:
- Procurement wants a 30-day contract review window; can impact timeline for Dedicated capacity if selected. Procurement contact (procurement@vertexinsights.com) is on the thread.
- Need clarity on expected peak concurrency to size Dedicated capacity. Tom to supply expected qps by next checkpoint.

Next steps:
- Stephanie will post the perf-run outputs to the Drive and add a short interpretation note.
- Diego will push a revised MAP with a recommended close/decision timeline for the execs (targeting week of 3/1).

Attachments referenced: Vertex_MAP_v1.xlsx, evaluation-checklist.pdf
Meeting recording: https://zoom.us/rec/share/vertex-kickoff-0225 (internal link)

Thanks everyone — see you next Tuesday at 11:00 PT.

Best,
Diego

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>, Lori Chen <lori@vertexinsights.com>, Tom Gleason <tom.g@vertexinsights.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@vertexinsights.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vertex MAP — Weekly checkpoints, owners & success criteria

Quick follow-up from Redwood's side after reading Diego's notes:

1) Timeline alignment: given the procurement window, recommend the following near-term decision points in the MAP sheet —
   - Week of 3/1: internal exec review & go/no-go recommendation (Redwood & Vertex product leads).
   - Week of 3/8: procurement & contracting alignment; finalize purchase order if Dedicated selected.

2) Commercial ask: to keep momentum, I'm prepared to offer a one-time evaluation credit (covering a two-week Dedicated burst) contingent on signing a term sheet by 3/12. Lori / procurement team — is that window feasible?

3) Please make sure the MAP has a clear acceptance sign-off row (success criteria met) and an owner for decision capture (Diego suggested). That will help us avoid scope creep during the evaluation.

Diego — can you add the timeline & trial-credit note to the MAP and circulate? I’ll help shepherd the commercial thread if Procurement has questions.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
